observations.detail: The historical ledger retains some visibly literal source notation, including q^{-1/2-h} in BF06, a_{chi,rho} and L_{chi,rho} in BF07, j_!/j_* in BF15, and caret/underscore notation in other ledger prose. These characters are visible and were not interpreted as missing glyphs or silently converted in this read-only review.
